item.title: New York's LaGuardia Airport closed after jet collides with firefighting vehicle
item.summary: An Air Canada regional jet struck a fire truck on the runway after landing at New York's LaGuardia Airport late Sunday night. Two people were killed, according to a person familiar with the investigation into the crash.

item.title: ICE's growing detention footprint, and the communities fighting back
item.summary: Resistance in both Democratic and Republican cities points to broader unease with the direction of immigration enforcement.

item.title: Worried about a shaky stock market? This is what financial advisers suggest you do
item.summary: Their answer depends on how soon you need to tap into your funds — and it might simply be "do nothing."

item.title: ICE officers set to deploy to airports as delays mount, border czar Homan confirms
item.summary: Border czar Tom Homan says ICE agents will help the Transportation Security Administration "move those lines" while also enforcing immigration law.

item.title: This lab that's determined to discover new drugs isn't where you might expect
item.summary: A scientist from Zambia who loves — LOVES! — chemistry runs a lab in South Africa that is being hailed for "extraordinary" work.

item.title: This local official thinks he may have the road map for Democrats to win big in 2026
item.summary: Some Democrats who were swept into office last November are grappling with the reality of governing. The new leader of Pennsylvania's Lehigh County says urgency is needed.

item.title: Sunday Puzzle: Brainteaser
item.summary: NPR'S Ayesha Rascoe plays the puzzle with KXJZ listener Jen Hart and Weekend Edition Puzzlemaster Will Shortz.

item.title: As D.C.'s cherry blossom trees near peak bloom, here's a guide to their history
item.summary: The renowned trees along Washington, D.C's Tidal Basin were sent as a gift from Japan in 1912. Some of the original trees are still there.

item.title: With more older drivers on the road, states try to balance safety and mobility
item.summary: The number of older drivers on the road is climbing. Safety advocates want tougher rules for relicensing, but many drivers say they shouldn't be forced to give up their mobility because of age alone.

item.title: What does a 'GLP-1 Friendly' diet look like? We asked nutritionists
item.summary: Big food companies are starting to market to people on the powerful new obesity meds with labels that say "GLP-1 Friendly." Nutritionists help us decode that message.
